name: Chronomancer: Rewind taught by Infinite Clone survives a talent change (#11657)
contract: Casting Infinite Clone (804492) casts 801299, whose second effect is SPELL_EFFECT_LEARN_SPELL for Rewind (801294), so the Chronomancer owns Rewind for as long as Infinite Clone is known. Buying Rippling Power (CharacterAdvancement entry 6162, spell 806300) synchronises the class progression; nothing in the data takes Rewind back, so the caster must still know it afterwards. Issue #11657.

steps.label: Infinite Clone must leave a living clone owned by the caster
Casting Infinite Clone must teach Rewind
Rewind must survive the talent change
